subject: prd/implement-now
statement: The executor shall parse plan/v2 demand, plan/v1 compatibility, default mappings, and repository overrides as closed versioned schemas; frozen semantic demand shall contain no harness, vendor product, native model, native effort, provider-specific context, or raw launch-argument identifier, and native identifiers shall exist only in harness-adapter policy and attempt evidence.
fit_criterion: every unknown key/enum, incompatible version, native-in-plan, and raw-argument fixture fails before claim; every harness adapter consumes the same semantic profile schema
